integrity: The theorem and rank are proved from incidence identities and finite-dimensional quadratic-form analysis. The embedded checker is optional reproducibility evidence, not an independent audit.
scientific_limitations: For k>=3, Steiner 2-(v,k,1) and r>k only, real Hilbert embeddings; excludes symmetric designs, other lambda, weights and arbitrary metric transforms. Older equivalent treatment cannot be ruled out; finite experiments are supporting checks rather than the general proof.
title: Sharp negative-type exponent and endpoint dimension for nonsymmetric Steiner incidence metrics
